meta.description: All context strings used in the Trelis protocol for BLAKE3 derive_key domain separation

notes.purpose: Context strings provide domain separation for key derivation. Each context string MUST be unique for its use case and MUST NOT change after protocol deployment.
notes.usage: Used with BLAKE3 derive_key(context, input) to derive keys
notes.test_input: 32 zero bytes used as input for reference output computation

vectors.name: hybrid_kem_context
vectors.description: Context for hybrid KEM shared secret combination (X448 + sntrup761)
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-hybrid/src/combiner.rs for combining X448 and sntrup761 shared secrets

vectors.name: session_context
vectors.description: Context for X3DH-PQ session key derivation from transcript
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/transcript.rs for deriving session shared secret

vectors.name: pq_ratchet_root_context
vectors.description: Context for double ratchet root key derivation
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (KDF_ROOT) for deriving new root keys during ratchet step

vectors.name: pq_ratchet_message_context
vectors.description: Context for double ratchet message key derivation
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (KDF_MESSAGE) for deriving message encryption keys

vectors.name: ratchet_nonce_context
vectors.description: Context for hedged nonce derivation in double ratchet
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/nonce.rs (NONCE_CONTEXT) for hedged nonce generation

vectors.name: safety_number_context
vectors.description: Context for safety number fingerprint derivation
vectors.usage: Used for deriving safety number fingerprints for identity verification

vectors.name: sig_prekey_bundle_context
vectors.description: Context for pre-key bundle signature prehash
vectors.usage: Used for prehashing pre-key bundle data before signing

vectors.name: bundle_wrap_context
vectors.description: Context for device key wrap encryption
vectors.usage: Used for wrapping device keys during key distribution

vectors.name: root_key_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial root key from X3DH-PQ shared secret
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (ROOT_KEY_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: send_chain_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial send chain key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (SEND_CHAIN_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: recv_chain_context
vectors.description: Context for deriving initial receive chain key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/session_keys.rs (RECV_CHAIN_CONTEXT) for session key derivation

vectors.name: ratchet_init_context
vectors.description: Context for initialising double ratchet from session key
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-ratchet/src/kdf.rs (derive_initial_root_key) for ratchet initialisation

vectors.name: device_revocation_context
vectors.description: Context for device revocation certificate signing
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-multidevice/src/revocation.rs (REVOCATION_CONTEXT) for device revocation

vectors.name: history_key_share_context
vectors.description: Context for history key sharing between devices
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-multidevice/src/history.rs (HISTORY_KEY_SHARE_CONTEXT) for sharing history access

vectors.name: prekey_bundle_domain
vectors.description: Domain separation prefix for pre-key bundle signing (used as bytes, not derive_key)
vectors.usage: Used in trelis-x3dh-pq/src/bundle.rs (BUNDLE_DOMAIN) as prefix for bundle signing data
